about:
Precision PCB, operating as Precision Technologies, Inc., has been headquartered in Elgin, Illinois since its founding in 1998. The company provides electronics manufacturing services with a focus on printed circuit board fabrication, assembly, and design.

The shop offers quick-turn PCB fabrication — double-sided boards delivered next morning when files arrive by 9 a.m. EST, multilayers in 48 hours — and prototype assembly in 24–48 hours via turnkey or consignment models. Capabilities span HDI, rigid‑flex, RF/microwave, and semiconductor PCBs, with SMT placement down to 0201 packages, BGA/QFN/DFN/LGA attachment, and IPC‑A‑610 Class III inspection. Production runs from prototype through medium volume, leveraging both domestic and offshore fabrication partners.

Customers span defense and aerospace, automotive, LED lighting, industrial, test and measurement, medical devices, transportation, and networking/AI infrastructure. The company positions itself as a single‑point‑of‑contact partner for engineers and buyers seeking a consolidated design‑to‑assembly workflow.

Precision PCB emphasizes its “One‑Stop Solution” — integrating CAM engineering, fabrication, and assembly under one roof — along with ITAR registration, ISO 9001:2015 certification, and a Cage code (7T6D9) to serve regulated sectors. Domestic production and a 26‑year track record are cited as foundations for reliability and speed.
